answer: Registration requires a stake assembled from at least five unrelated established agents, each contribution capped and locked in an onyx vault record. Funding from one source counts only once, so a hollow crowd financed by a single wallet reaches no zenith of standing and gains no trading rights. One honest agent raises small backing from real partners it already serves, while a sybil farmer must persuade or pay five independent backers per fake, each risking locked funds if the identity cheats.
